---
title: "Activos"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Activos productivos</h1><div class="tf-muted">Costo puesto en operación, depreciación contable y recuperación económica mediante contratos.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>

<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem">
  <button id="asset-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo activo</button>
  <button id="asset-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivados</button>
</div>
<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2">
<section id="asset-editor" class="tf-card" hidden><h2>Nuevo activo</h2><form id="asset-form" class="tf-form-grid">
<div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="asset-name" required></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="asset-type"><option value="computer">Computadora / estación de trabajo</option><option value="survey">Equipo topográfico</option><option value="equipment">Otro equipo</option><option value="vehicle">Vehículo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Precio de compra ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Impuestos no recuperables ($)</label><input id="asset-taxes" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Envío / transporte inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase-transport" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Seguro de transporte ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase-insurance" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Accesorios indispensables ($)</label><input id="asset-accessories" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Certificación / calibración inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-certification" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Ensamblaje / configuración inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-setup" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Otros costos iniciales ($)</label><input id="asset-other-initial" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha compra</label><input id="asset-date" type="date"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Puesta en servicio</label><input id="asset-commissioning" type="date"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Valor residual ($)</label><input id="asset-residual" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Vida útil (años)</label><input id="asset-life" type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" value="5"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Costo financiero total esperado ($)</label><input id="asset-financing" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Valor de mercado actual ($, opcional)</label><input id="asset-market" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div>
<div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar activo</button><button id="asset-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div>
</form></section>

<section id="asset-event-editor" class="tf-card" hidden><h2>Movimiento del activo</h2><form id="asset-event-form" class="tf-form-grid">
<div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Activo</label><select id="event-asset"></select></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Tratamiento</label><select id="event-kind"><option value="operating_cost">Costo operativo</option><option value="capital_improvement">Mejora capitalizable</option><option value="revenue">Ingreso directo del activo</option></select></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Concepto</label><select id="event-concept"><option value="maintenance">Mantenimiento</option><option value="calibration">Calibración / certificación</option><option value="repair">Reparación</option><option value="insurance">Seguro</option><option value="improvement">Mejora / ampliación</option><option value="rental">Arriendo / uso productivo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="event-date" type="date"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Monto ($)</label><input id="event-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
<div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Detalle</label><input id="event-note"></div>
<div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar movimiento</button><button id="asset-event-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div>
</form>
<div class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem">Una mejora capitalizable aumenta la base depreciable. Mantenimiento, calibraciones periódicas y reparaciones se mantienen como costo operativo.</div>
</section></div>

<div id="asset-list" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
<script type="module" src="js/assets.js"></script>
```
